Everly.description: Rounded, soft-edged tone with gentle lift at the end of phrases and an easy, relaxed delivery.

Harper.description: Modern, confident and friendly voice with a standard American accent.

Hadley.description: Settled, even-toned and genuinely kind, with crisp consonants that hold up over a handset.

Delia.description: Low, grounded and quick to the point, with a sincerity that keeps an apology honest.

Trevor.description: Buoyant energy over a resonant mid-low core, phrases landing softly and consonants cutting through a handset.

Preston.description: Trim, focused delivery with clean edges on every consonant and a steady, low-set core that carries through phone bandwidth.

Hugh.description: Soft and close, airy in texture, with lively pitch movement and an attentive, sincere delivery.

Edwin.description: Efficient and firm, sincere in attention, with tidy articulation that holds up at phone bandwidth.

Spencer.description: Light and airy, sitting a touch higher, with crisp consonants and a slow, patient delivery.

Bryony.description: Full, rich mid-range tones, softly relaxed and spoken close to the mic, moving briskly with light pitch play.
